notes.title: Visit us at LFG Con in Hof (GERMANY)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that we will be attending LFG Con in Hof on May 4th to showcase our game, Brains n' Bullets.

[b]Brains n' Bullets is a unique shooter, that allows players to improve their school grades while playing. By learning vocabulary and other academic content while fighting with their team on tactical maps to conquer bases, players can have fun while also enhancing their knowledge.[/b]


We will be available on-site to answer any questions you may have about the game or to test the game in a multiplayer session to help you better understand the game concept. 


If you are a journalist interested in writing about the game, please send us a brief introduction and a suggested time for you to test.

[b]info@gamelynk.io[/b]




Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience Brains n' Bullets for yourself!

Event details:
Where: Freiheitshalle Hof, Kulmbacher Str. 4, 95030 Hof (Germany)
When: May 4th

For more information, please visit [url=https://lfg-con.de/#faq]https://lfg-con.de/#faq[/url]
